I've replied to Dana in her #north-team thread: the deadline for the signed Tamsin Cold Chain order form is 20 November.

I also told her I couldn't check the date against the paperwork, because I can't find any Tamsin files in the share. Ilse can confirm it if Dana wants it double-checked before it goes in the tracker.
